[1msnetwork test[0m [2m·[0m where am I on the network, at a glance

[1;33mUSAGE[0m
  snetwork                       the summary: every section, a few lines each
  snetwork [36mSECTION[0m [36m[ITEM][0m       one section in full [2m· see[0m snetwork -h sections
  snetwork all                   every section in full

[1;33mPROBES[0m  [2mplain snetwork sends no packets[0m
  [32m--active[0m[36m[=30s][0m            also probe: sweep this LAN (a /24 at most), ping the
                         gateway and tailnet peers, time DNS, scan Wi-Fi, ask the
                         internet. Changes nothing. The interval is for --watch.
  [32m--watch[0m[36m[=2s][0m              redraw every interval and mark changes: green new,
                         yellow older, red gone. The interval needs the "=".

[1;33mOTHER MACHINES[0m  [2mover ssh; they need snetwork too[0m
  [32m--via[0m [36mHOST[0m             run on HOST and show its answer here
  [32m-no-remote[0m             do not ask tailnet routers about the subnets behind them
                         [2m(full views ask; plain snetwork never does)[0m

[1;33mOUTPUT[0m
  [32m-json[0m                  the same data as JSON
  [32m-no-color[0m              no colour [2m(also off when output is not a terminal)[0m

[1;33mOTHER[0m
  [32m-v, -version[0m           print the version
  [32m-h, -help[0m [36m[TOPIC][0m      this help [2m· topics:[0m sections[2m,[0m env

[1;33mEXAMPLES[0m
  snetwork --active              [2m# everything, probed; pending values show as …[0m
  snetwork vpn --watch           [2m# tailnet peers, redrawn every 2 s[0m
  snetwork devices 10.0.1.0/24   [2m# asks the tailnet peer that routes that subnet[0m
  snetwork all > network.txt     [2m# everything, no colour[0m

[2mFlags go before or after the section, and -json and --json both work.[0m
